|lore=Capital starships have emergency escape pods. Equipped with food, water, flares, medpacs, hunting blaster and tracking beacon (R2-D2 deactivated this one’s beacon).
|game_text=Take a dejarik, hologram, or holosite into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a holosite. OR If opponent is about to place your character out of play, place that character in your Lost Pile instead.
|printings={{Card versions/Escape Pod (Premiere)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip puts the Reserve Deck option before the holosite drain and out-of-play options. The [[Escape Pod (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 1 June 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date. The [[Escape Pod (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
